text: My day usually starts at six-thirty, when my alarm clock rings. After a quick shower, I make a pot of coffee and review my to-do list for the day. By eight o'clock, I'm at my desk, starting work. I spend the morning answering emails and attending meetings, then take a short lunch break to walk outside. After work, I go to the gym for about an hour, which helps me clear my head. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, and watch a little television. I'm usually in bed by ten, and this consistent routine keeps me feeling focused and relaxed.
